title: The Cap
lines: Dan and a dog sit on a mat.
A tan cap is on Dan. A bat is in a bin.
The dog and Dan tug at the cap.
The dog can tug it to the bin.
Mud is on the dog and the cap!
Pam can tip the cap in a tub of mud.
The mud is in the tub!
Dan and Pam pat the dog.
scoring_note: Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
